start.text: That's Mara's gull on your token. Right, then. Right.
Stay on the boardwalk. Keep that ember high. And if you start forgetting why you went — turn round, that's what she told us.

shut.text: Lofts are shut. Harbormaster's orders. Folk go in for a net and come out asking whose net it is.
You want past, you want Mara's say-so. Brass, with a gull on it.

lofts.text: The net-lofts, then the headland, then the Gull's Beacon. Used to be you could see it from the harbor. Now you can't see your own boots past the third loft.

hesk.text: Old Hesk. Wouldn't come out when the rest of us ran. She's still up there mending, humming. She won't know you.
She taught me every knot I've got. Doesn't know my name now.

start_lit.text: I can see the beacon from the gate. First time since the Snuffing. I keep looking, in case it goes out.
Hesk's stopped humming. The lofts are quiet as a church. I don't know if that's better.
